title: Unvisited work-tape cells are unchanged
statement: Let $M$ be a nondeterministic multi-tape Turing machine, let $w$ be a choice word, and let $c$ be a configuration on a fixed input. For every work tape $i$ and every integer cell position $z$, if the initial head position on tape $i$ plus $|w|$ is at most $z$, then the content of cell $z$ on tape $i$ after running under $w$ equals its initial content.
hypotheses_covered: nondeterministic machine M with k work tapes
configuration c on a fixed input
initial head position on tape i plus |w| is at most z
